info.name: Errand Catcher - Local
info.description:
API test for errand catcher where it can only run by localhost  
Set up first database in MySQL in order to proceed API testing  
After successfully sign up/register new user, add new request GET /verify-email  
Params tab:

| Key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `token` | the actual token from your database |

**To get the token:**  
Run this in MySQL Workbench:

SELECT token FROM email_verification_tokens;

Copy one of the tokens and paste it as the value in Postman.
